title: SvgFeSpecularLighting
responsibility: Renders the native feSpecularLighting element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgFeSpecularLighting.attributes
inputs.description: Native feSpecularLighting attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgFeSpecularLighting.children

outputs.name: SvgFeSpecularLighting
